messages.author: bd4b872fec77725b
messages.subject: convert fit() results in xdr file to text format
parts:
Hi,

I searched email archive, and found two related topics, which
tell us to use fit() to retrieve the contents in xdr files, which I
did:


fit.results<-fit(cbs,verbose=verbose).

But, could you please tell me how to write the fit.results in
text format so that the other unix program can process them, not for
ChromosomeExplorer(cbs) purpose ?

Thanks,

Qicheng

messages.author: bd4b872fec77725b
messages.subject: data structures for segment data recorded in xdr files
parts:
Hi Henrik,

Is it possible to set an option in the fit(cbs,verbose=verbose)
so that outputs are in the text format instead of xdr format ? If not,
possible, I need to write a C program to parse the xdr file generated
by fitting the Cbsmodel, from the segment() method in DNAcopy
package, it says:

"Value:

a data frame with six columns. Each row of the data frame
contains a segment for which there are six variables: the sample
id, the chromosome number, the map position of the start of the
segment, the map position of the end of the segment, the number
of
markers in the segment, and the average value in the segment.
"
Could you please tell me the data types for these six fields so
that I can use the corresponding c functions to extract these six
fields, e.g., xdr_char, xdr_long, xdr_double?

Thanks,

Qicheng
